name: Model Turnkey: Qwen3.6-27B NVFP4 (1x Blackwell)
readme: Lower-cost development profile for nvidia/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4. Deploy on 1x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell or GeForce RTX 5090. The profile downloads about 21 GiB, defaults to a 32K text-only context, disables DRAM KV offload and MTP until explicitly tested, and mounts persistent storage at /workspace. Ports 1111 and 8000 use Runpod managed HTTPS for the dashboard and secure API fallback. In a private clone, add DESEC_TOKEN and DESEC_DOMAIN through Runpod Secrets to make port 8443 a direct appliance-TLS route that avoids Runpod proxy's 100-second limit.
